consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1988-12-31 show at Oakland Coliseum Arena was a high-energy performance with great song selection, particularly praising the contributions of Clarence Clemons on saxophone. Many attendees felt the overall vibe of the show was special, with memorable moments and strong interplay among the band members.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 39 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans celebrated the energy and performance, some reviews noted that it didn't rank among the best shows, leading to a mixed overall sentiment.
